start: Prior closed M5 in authorized direction outside original 0.5ATR EMA zone, then first closed M5 in zone; freeze symbol/direction/start identity and start low/high
authorization: Only previous closed M15 authorization available at M5 time; cannot backfill current M15 authorization into earlier M5
continuation: Repeated touches do not change episode start or create a new opportunity
confirmation: Original M5 near-extreme pattern first confirmed on a STRICTLY later closed M5; same-bar start/pattern not accepted
end: Direction/contract change, session gap greater than one M5, 6 actual M5 bars since start, or closed price strictly beyond frozen start low for bull/high for bear
expiry_origin: 6 bars reuses original evidence lookback as a NEW lifecycle policy, not claimed as original validity
break_rule: Close beyond frozen START boundary; NEW strategy rule, NOT confirmation-bar intraminute extreme crossing
consumption: First eligible M15 observes stable episode+confirmation ID; original 30 second execution clock does not renew; fills consume; historical confirmed pattern IDs never attach to a new process
after_end: Require a new directionally outside-zone closed M5 before another zone entry; tombstones persist across restart
truth: Original unordered B is baseline; this is a new mechanism, not a bugfix or profitability claim
